Controls_ABorderedCollectionWhoseEqualHe.en-US: A bordered collection whose equal-height rows share one moving interaction indicator.
Controls_ABorderedCollectionWhoseEqualHe.zh-CN: 带边框的集合，其中等高行共用一个移动的交互指示器。

Controls_ABorderedListForOrdinarySelecta.en-US: A bordered list for ordinary selectable content.
Controls_ABorderedListForOrdinarySelecta.zh-CN: 适用于普通可选内容的带边框列表。

Controls_ABorderedSurfaceForMultiplePara.en-US: A bordered surface for multiple paragraphs.
Controls_ABorderedSurfaceForMultiplePara.zh-CN: 用于承载多个段落的带边框界面。

Controls_ABorderlessListForShellNavigati.en-US: A borderless list for shell navigation items and group labels.
Controls_ABorderlessListForShellNavigati.zh-CN: 适用于 Shell 导航项和分组标签的无边框列表。

Controls_ABorderlessNavigationCollection.en-US: A borderless navigation collection with the same coordinated state layer and inherited item semantics.
Controls_ABorderlessNavigationCollection.zh-CN: 无边框的导航集合，使用相同的协调状态层并继承项目语义。

Controls_ACardShapedActionWhoseCompleteS.en-US: A card-shaped action whose complete surface participates in button interaction.
Controls_ACardShapedActionWhoseCompleteS.zh-CN: 整个表面都参与按钮交互的卡片式操作。

Controls_ACompactScrollableViewportForAp.en-US: A compact scrollable viewport for append-only logs, progress, results, and failures.
Controls_ACompactScrollableViewportForAp.zh-CN: 用于追加式日志、进度、结果和失败信息的紧凑可滚动视口。

Controls_AConciseDisplayOnlySurfaceWithO.en-US: A concise display-only surface with optional title, content, and one icon.
Controls_AConciseDisplayOnlySurfaceWithO.zh-CN: 具有可选标题、内容和单个图标的简洁只读界面。

Controls_ACustomViewportBindsItsOffsetSc.en-US: A custom viewport binds its offset, scrollable range, and visible extent to FlourishScrollBar. Keep Value two-way so pointer and keyboard changes immediately update the viewport, and set Orientation to Horizontal with the corresponding width bindings for a horizontal surface. Prefer ScrollViewer for ordinary application content because it creates and coordinates these bars automatically.
Controls_ACustomViewportBindsItsOffsetSc.zh-CN: 自定义视口将其偏移量、可滚动范围和可见范围绑定到 FlourishScrollBar。请让 Value 保持双向绑定，以便指针和键盘操作立即更新视口；对于水平区域，将 Orientation 设为 Horizontal，并绑定相应宽度。普通应用内容应优先使用 ScrollViewer，因为它会自动创建并协调这些滚动条。

Controls_ADedicatedTitleBarActionWithCap.en-US: A dedicated title-bar action with caption geometry and window interaction semantics.
Controls_ADedicatedTitleBarActionWithCap.zh-CN: 具有标题栏几何结构和窗口交互语义的专用操作。

Controls_ADisabledCardButtonKeepsTheComp.en-US: A disabled CardButton keeps the complete card unavailable and presents the disabled treatment across every visual region.
Controls_ADisabledCardButtonKeepsTheComp.zh-CN: 禁用的 CardButton 会使整张卡片不可用，并在所有视觉区域中呈现禁用样式。

Controls_ADisabledItemRemainsVisibleWhil.en-US: A disabled item remains visible while its tooltip explains why the option is unavailable.
Controls_ADisabledItemRemainsVisibleWhil.zh-CN: 禁用的项目仍保持可见，其工具提示会说明该选项不可用的原因。

Controls_ADraggableDividerBetweenGridReg.en-US: A draggable divider between Grid regions.
Controls_ADraggableDividerBetweenGridReg.zh-CN: Grid 区域之间可拖动的分隔条。

Controls_AFixedCardLayoutForOneSettingOr.en-US: A fixed card layout for one setting or local action with one interactive body.
Controls_AFixedCardLayoutForOneSettingOr.zh-CN: 用于单个设置或局部操作、且仅包含一个交互式 Body 的固定卡片布局。

Controls_AFixedSettingRowOrVerticalLocal.en-US: A fixed setting row or vertical local action.
Controls_AFixedSettingRowOrVerticalLocal.zh-CN: 固定的设置行或纵向局部操作。

Controls_AFloatingContainerForTransientS.en-US: A floating container for transient surfaces.
Controls_AFloatingContainerForTransientS.zh-CN: 用于临时界面的浮动容器。

Controls_AFullWidthSectionForOnePageTopi.en-US: A full-width section for one page topic.
Controls_AFullWidthSectionForOnePageTopi.zh-CN: 用于承载单个页面主题的全宽区块。

Controls_ALabelThatTargetsAnInputOrPrese.en-US: A label that targets an input or presents a caption.
Controls_ALabelThatTargetsAnInputOrPrese.zh-CN: 用于指向输入控件或显示说明的标签。

Controls_AListWhoseParentLayerMovesInter.en-US: A list whose parent layer moves interaction feedback between items.
Controls_AListWhoseParentLayerMovesInter.zh-CN: 由父级层在子项之间移动交互反馈的列表。

Controls_AQuietNeutralSurfaceForSupporti.en-US: A quiet neutral surface for supporting information.
Controls_AQuietNeutralSurfaceForSupporti.zh-CN: 用于辅助信息的低调中性界面。

Controls_ARaisedSurfaceForInformationAbo.en-US: A raised surface for information above nearby content.
Controls_ARaisedSurfaceForInformationAbo.zh-CN: 用于将信息提升到相邻内容上方的凸起界面。

Controls_ASemanticHeadingForACompactCont.en-US: A semantic heading for a compact content surface.
Controls_ASemanticHeadingForACompactCont.zh-CN: 适用于紧凑内容区域的语义标题。

Controls_ASeparateGroupNameCreatesAnothe.en-US: A separate GroupName creates another independent decision in the same page.
Controls_ASeparateGroupNameCreatesAnothe.zh-CN: 另一个 GroupName 可在同一页面中创建独立的另一项决策。

Controls_ASharedGroupNameGuaranteesThatO.en-US: A shared GroupName guarantees that only one option stays checked.
Controls_ASharedGroupNameGuaranteesThatO.zh-CN: 共享 GroupName 可确保只有一个选项保持选中。

Controls_ASingleParentOwnedLayerRendersH.en-US: A single parent-owned layer renders hover and pressed feedback. Single selection uses one moving indicator; multiple selection keeps one realized indicator per selected item.
Controls_ASingleParentOwnedLayerRendersH.zh-CN: 由父级负责的单一图层呈现悬停与按下反馈。单选使用一个移动指示器；多选则为每个已选中的已实现项目保留一个指示器。

Controls_AStandardActionWithOptionalCont.en-US: A standard action with optional content and icon.
Controls_AStandardActionWithOptionalCont.zh-CN: 带有可选内容和图标的标准操作。

Controls_AStrongSurfaceForProminentInfor.en-US: A strong surface for prominent information.
Controls_AStrongSurfaceForProminentInfor.zh-CN: 用于突出信息的高强调界面。

Controls_AThemedScrollbarForExplicitScro.en-US: A themed scrollbar for explicit scrolling.
Controls_AThemedScrollbarForExplicitScro.zh-CN: 用于显式滚动的主题化滚动条。

Controls_AThemedTipSurfaceForConciseAssi.en-US: A themed tip surface for concise assistance.
Controls_AThemedTipSurfaceForConciseAssi.zh-CN: 用于提供简洁帮助的主题化提示界面。

Controls_AViewportForContentLargerThanIt.en-US: A viewport for content larger than its available space.
Controls_AViewportForContentLargerThanIt.zh-CN: 用于显示超出可用空间内容的视口。

Controls_AVisibleCollectionWithSelection.en-US: A visible collection with selection behavior.
Controls_AVisibleCollectionWithSelection.zh-CN: 具有选择行为的可视集合。

Controls_AWindowSpecificCaptionAction_28.zh-CN: 窗口专用的标题栏操作。

Controls_AcceptsReturnAndTextWrappingCre.en-US: AcceptsReturn and TextWrapping create a bounded multiline editor.
Controls_AcceptsReturnAndTextWrappingCre.zh-CN: AcceptsReturn 和 TextWrapping 可创建有边界的多行编辑器。

Controls_AccessibleApplicationActionsBui.en-US: Accessible application actions built on the WPF button contract.
Controls_AccessibleApplicationActionsBui.zh-CN: 基于 WPF 按钮约定构建的无障碍应用操作。

Controls_AddPageScopedToolbarActionsUpda.en-US: Add page-scoped toolbar actions, update their enabled and visible states, change presentation and order, or remove them when the owning workflow ends. Use toolbar items for frequently accessed commands tied to a page; the code below demonstrates registration and the complete item-management lifecycle.
Controls_AddPageScopedToolbarActionsUpda.zh-CN: 添加页面作用域的工具栏操作，更新其启用和可见状态，更改呈现方式和顺序，或在所属工作流结束时移除它们。工具栏项目适用于与页面相关的常用命令；以下代码演示注册和完整的项目管理生命周期。

Controls_AddParagraphElementsDirectlyToD.en-US: Add Paragraph elements directly to Document. Each Paragraph.Text also supports resources and view-model bindings. Document owns the rounded reading surface, paragraph spacing, and first-line indentation, so it should normally be the only Body of its Chunk; use Card instead for one short passage.
Controls_AddParagraphElementsDirectlyToD.zh-CN: 将 Paragraph 元素直接添加到 Document。每个 Paragraph.Text 也支持资源和视图模型绑定。Document 负责圆角阅读界面、段落间距和首行缩进，因此通常应作为其 Chunk 中唯一的 Body；单段短文本则使用 Card。

Controls_AddTheGalleryRuntimeActionOrRef.en-US: Add the Gallery runtime action or refresh its registration.
Controls_AddTheGalleryRuntimeActionOrRef.zh-CN: 添加 Gallery 运行时操作或刷新其注册。

Controls_AddThePersistentItemOrUpdateIts.en-US: Add the persistent item or update its current text.
Controls_AddThePersistentItemOrUpdateIts.zh-CN: 添加持久项目或更新其当前文本。

Controls_AddsElevationToSeparateAnAction.en-US: Adds elevation to separate an action from its surrounding surface.
Controls_AddsElevationToSeparateAnAction.zh-CN: 通过增加高度层级，使操作与周围界面区分开。

Controls_AddsElevationWhileTheCompleteSu.en-US: Adds elevation while the complete surface remains interactive.
Controls_AddsElevationWhileTheCompleteSu.zh-CN: 在保持整个表面可交互的同时增加高度层级。

Controls_AddsOptionalSupportingContext_5.zh-CN: 添加可选的辅助上下文。

Controls_AddsSupportingPageContext_DE572.zh-CN: 添加辅助性的页面上下文。

Controls_AddsTheStandardSeparationFromCh.en-US: Adds the standard separation from Chunk title and content copy.
Controls_AddsTheStandardSeparationFromCh.zh-CN: 添加与 Chunk 标题及内容文案之间的标准间距。

Controls_AlignsContentWithinTheLabelBoun.en-US: Aligns content within the label bounds.
Controls_AlignsContentWithinTheLabelBoun.zh-CN: 在标签边界内对齐内容。

Controls_AlignsTheTitleAndCopyGroupHoriz.zh-CN: 在水平方向上对齐标题与文案组。

Controls_AlignsTheTitleAndCopyGroupVerti.zh-CN: 在垂直方向上对齐标题与文案组。

Controls_AllowsTheControlToEnterTheIndet.en-US: Allows the control to enter the indeterminate state.
Controls_AllowsTheControlToEnterTheIndet.zh-CN: 允许控件进入不确定状态。

Controls_AllowsTheEnterKeyToInsertANewLi.en-US: Allows the Enter key to insert a new line.
Controls_AllowsTheEnterKeyToInsertANewLi.zh-CN: 允许使用 Enter 键插入新行。

Controls_AnEntireCardSurfaceThatResponds.en-US: An entire card surface that responds as a button.
Controls_AnEntireCardSurfaceThatResponds.zh-CN: 整个卡片表面都能像按钮一样响应交互。

Controls_AnIconGlyphRenderedThroughTheCo.en-US: An icon glyph rendered through the configured icon family.
Controls_AnIconGlyphRenderedThroughTheCo.zh-CN: 使用已配置图标字体系列呈现的图标字形。

Controls_AnchoredFloatingContentWithTwoD.en-US: Anchored floating content with two dismissal contracts.
Controls_AnchoredFloatingContentWithTwoD.zh-CN: 具有两种关闭约定的锚定浮动内容。

Controls_AppendASummaryOfTheCurrentOutpu.en-US: Append a summary of the current Output value.
Controls_AppendASummaryOfTheCurrentOutpu.zh-CN: 追加当前 Output 值的摘要。

Controls_AppendOneTimestampedMessage_AEC.zh-CN: 追加一条带时间戳的消息。

Controls_AppendsOneLineAndScrollsTheView.en-US: Appends one line and scrolls the viewport to the latest output.
Controls_AppendsOneLineAndScrollsTheView.zh-CN: 追加一行，并将视口滚动到最新输出。

Controls_ApplySemanticFlourishTypography.en-US: Apply semantic Flourish typography roles without locally reproducing font resources.
Controls_ApplySemanticFlourishTypography.zh-CN: 应用 Flourish 语义排版角色，无需在局部重复定义字体资源。

Controls_AsksTheHostToCloseTheSurface_82.en-US: Asks the host to close the surface.

Controls_AssignAFlourishToolTipInstanceW.en-US: Assign a FlourishToolTip instance when placement, open state, or another ToolTip property needs explicit configuration. This path is appropriate for a reusable tooltip control or richer content that still remains concise and supplemental.
Controls_AssignAFlourishToolTipInstanceW.zh-CN: 当定位、打开状态或其他 ToolTip 属性需要显式配置时，请分配 FlourishToolTip 实例。此方式适用于可复用的工具提示控件，或仍保持简洁、起补充作用的丰富内容。

Controls_AssignASupportingControlThrough.en-US: Assign a supporting control through Presenter.Body. Body stays in the same copy-side region as Title and Content and follows their left alignment instead of joining Presentation.
Controls_AssignASupportingControlThrough.zh-CN: 通过 Presenter.Body 指定辅助控件。Body 与 Title 和 Content 保持在同一个文案侧区域，并沿用其左对齐方式，而不会加入 Presentation。

Controls_AssignTheCompleteSourceSnippetT.en-US: Assign the complete source snippet through Text. Encode line breaks as character entities for inline XAML, or bind Text for longer and generated examples. Updating a binding replaces both the displayed and copied value, while an empty value disables the built-in copy action.
Controls_AssignTheCompleteSourceSnippetT.zh-CN: 通过 Text 指定完整的源代码片段。在内联 XAML 中将换行编码为字符实体；对于较长或生成的示例，则绑定 Text。更新绑定会同时替换显示值和复制值；空值会禁用内置复制操作。

Controls_AssociatesMutuallyExclusiveOpti.en-US: Associates mutually exclusive options across a logical container.
Controls_AssociatesMutuallyExclusiveOpti.zh-CN: 在逻辑容器中关联互斥选项。

Controls_AtTheBoundaryInputMayBubbleToPa.en-US: At the boundary, input may bubble to PageBody.
Controls_AtTheBoundaryInputMayBubbleToPa.zh-CN: 到达边界时，输入可以冒泡至 PageBody。

Controls_BindADataCollectionExactlyAsYou.en-US: Bind a data collection exactly as you would for ListBox. Generated containers are BunchedListBoxItem instances, so no per-item hover surface is required.
Controls_BindADataCollectionExactlyAsYou.zh-CN: 按照 ListBox 的方式绑定数据集合。生成的容器是 BunchedListBoxItem 实例，因此无需为每个项目单独创建悬停表面。

Controls_BindASharedCommandWhenSelecting.en-US: Bind a shared Command when selecting an option must invoke application behavior. CommandParameter carries each option value, avoiding a separate Checked handler for every radio button.
Controls_BindASharedCommandWhenSelecting.zh-CN: 当选择选项必须调用应用行为时，请绑定共享 Command。CommandParameter 携带各选项的值，从而无需为每个单选按钮编写独立的 Checked 处理程序。

Controls_BindCommandForReusableActionsOr.en-US: Bind Command for reusable actions, or handle Click for local behavior.
Controls_BindCommandForReusableActionsOr.zh-CN: 为可复用操作绑定 Command，或通过 Click 处理局部行为。

Controls_BindCommandToApplicationLogicAn.en-US: Bind Command to application logic and set Content for the visible label. Add Icon when it improves recognition; either region collapses when omitted. Use Filled for a primary action, Tonal or Outlined for supporting actions, Text for low emphasis, and Danger only for destructive work.
Controls_BindCommandToApplicationLogicAn.zh-CN: 将 Command 绑定到应用逻辑，并通过 Content 设置可见标签。在图标有助于识别时添加 Icon；任一区域省略后都会自动折叠。主要操作使用 Filled，辅助操作使用 Tonal 或 Outlined，低强调操作使用 Text，Danger 仅用于破坏性操作。

Controls_BindItemsSourceAndUseNativeWPFD.en-US: Bind ItemsSource and use native WPF DataGrid columns. Disable automatic columns when visible fields and order are part of the design, and use IsReadOnly for reference or result tables. Native selection properties can bind an active row to another view; Flourish also hands the mouse wheel to PageBody when the grid reaches its scroll boundary.
Controls_BindItemsSourceAndUseNativeWPFD.zh-CN: 绑定 ItemsSource 并使用原生 WPF DataGrid 列。当可见字段和顺序属于设计的一部分时，请禁用自动生成列；参考表或结果表应使用 IsReadOnly。原生选择属性可将活动行绑定到另一个视图；当网格到达滚动边界时，Flourish 还会将鼠标滚轮交还给 PageBody。

Controls_BindItemsSourceForApplicationDa.en-US: Bind ItemsSource for application data; the control creates FlourishListBoxItem containers automatically.
Controls_BindItemsSourceForApplicationDa.zh-CN: 将 ItemsSource 绑定到应用数据；控件会自动创建 FlourishListBoxItem 容器。

Controls_BindItemsSourceToApplicationDat.en-US: Bind ItemsSource to application data and SelectedItem in TwoWay mode when selection belongs to the view model. DisplayMemberPath selects the label for non-string items. Handle SelectionChanged only when added or removed selections must trigger immediate view-owned work beyond the binding update.
Controls_BindItemsSourceToApplicationDat.zh-CN: 将 ItemsSource 绑定到应用数据；当选择属于视图模型时，以 TwoWay 模式绑定 SelectedItem。DisplayMemberPath 用于选择非字符串项目显示的标签。仅当添加或移除选择必须立即触发绑定更新之外的视图工作时，才处理 SelectionChanged。

Controls_BindSelectedItemOrSelectedValue.en-US: Bind SelectedItem or SelectedValue to the view model. IsCompact affects navigation geometry without changing selection state.
Controls_BindSelectedItemOrSelectedValue.zh-CN: 将 SelectedItem 或 SelectedValue 绑定到视图模型。IsCompact 会影响导航几何尺寸，但不会改变选择状态。

Controls_BindTextInTwoWayModeWhenTheValu.en-US: Bind Text in TwoWay mode when the value belongs to a view model, and choose PropertyChanged only when every edit must update the source. MaxLength limits input at the control boundary. Name the control when code must replace, select, or focus its value through the native TextBox methods.
Controls_BindTextInTwoWayModeWhenTheValu.zh-CN: 当值属于视图模型时，以 TwoWay 模式绑定 Text；仅当每次编辑都必须更新数据源时才选择 PropertyChanged。MaxLength 会在控件边界限制输入。当代码需要通过 TextBox 原生方法替换、选择或聚焦其值时，请为控件命名。

Controls_BindTextWithPropertyChangedUpda.en-US: Bind Text with PropertyChanged updates when results should react continuously as the query changes. TextChanged is an alternative for lightweight view-owned filtering. Placeholder guides an empty field but does not replace a visible label when the search purpose is ambiguous.
Controls_BindTextWithPropertyChangedUpda.zh-CN: 当结果需要随查询变化而持续响应时，请使用 PropertyChanged 更新绑定 Text。对于视图自行负责的轻量筛选，也可使用 TextChanged。Placeholder 可提示空字段，但当搜索用途不明确时，不能替代可见标签。

Controls_BindsAnApplicationOwnedParagrap.en-US: Binds an application-owned paragraph collection when needed.
Controls_BindsAnApplicationOwnedParagrap.zh-CN: 在需要时绑定应用自身的段落集合。

Controls_BodyParagraphCaptionMutedFieldL.en-US: Body, Paragraph, Caption, Muted, FieldLabel, Subtitle, Description, CardTitle, SectionTitle, PageTitle, Status, and Icon are available. Prefer the owning higher-level control for structural titles.
Controls_BodyParagraphCaptionMutedFieldL.zh-CN: 可用角色包括 Body、Paragraph、Caption、Muted、FieldLabel、Subtitle、Description、CardTitle、SectionTitle、PageTitle、Status 和 Icon。对于结构性标题，应优先使用负责该结构的上层控件。

Controls_BothAppearancesUseTheSameSelect.en-US: Both appearances use the same selection model and an equal-height demonstration surface.
Controls_BothAppearancesUseTheSameSelect.zh-CN: 两种外观使用相同的选择模型和等高演示区域。

Controls_BothLayoutRolesUseTheSame4DIPIn.en-US: Both layout roles use the same 4 DIP interaction surface, centered 2 DIP highlight, and immediate resizing. NavigationPane changes only shell-edge alignment and column-resize defaults.
Controls_BothLayoutRolesUseTheSame4DIPIn.zh-CN: 两种布局角色使用相同的 4 DIP 交互表面、居中的 2 DIP 高亮线和即时调整。NavigationPane 仅更改 Shell 边缘对齐方式和列调整默认值。

Controls_BrowseEveryPublicFlourishContro.en-US: Browse every public Flourish control from one navigation overview.
Controls_BrowseEveryPublicFlourishContro.zh-CN: 从一个导航总览中浏览 Flourish 的所有公共控件。

Controls_BrowseTheFlourishSourceReposito.zh-CN: 浏览 Flourish 源代码仓库。

Controls_BunchedListBoxItemKeepsItsInter.en-US: BunchedListBoxItem keeps its interaction background transparent so the parent-owned HoverReveal layer remains visible.
Controls_BunchedListBoxItemKeepsItsInter.zh-CN: BunchedListBoxItem 会让自身交互背景保持透明，从而显示由父级负责的 HoverReveal 图层。

Controls_CallWriteLineForEachObservableR.en-US: Call WriteLine for each observable result so existing history remains available. Use Clear only when the workflow deliberately begins a new output session; overflow remains accessible in the control's scrolling viewport.
Controls_CallWriteLineForEachObservableR.zh-CN: 为每个可观察结果调用 WriteLine，以保留现有历史。仅当工作流明确开始新的输出会话时才使用 Clear；溢出内容仍可通过控件的滚动视口访问。

Controls_ChooseNavigationPaneOnlyForTheD.en-US: Choose NavigationPane only for the divider at a shell navigation edge. The variant supplies horizontal column resizing, edge alignment, cursor, and layer defaults while retaining the same geometry and thin live-resize highlight as Standard. The surrounding Grid continues to define minimum and available widths.
Controls_ChooseNavigationPaneOnlyForTheD.zh-CN: 仅将 NavigationPane 用于 Shell 导航边缘的分隔线。此变体提供水平列调整、边缘对齐、光标和图层默认值，同时保留与 Standard 相同的几何尺寸和细窄实时高亮线。周围的 Grid 仍负责定义最小宽度和可用宽度。

Controls_ChooseOneValueFromACompactColle.en-US: Choose one value from a compact collection using Flourish item containers.
Controls_ChooseOneValueFromACompactColle.zh-CN: 使用 Flourish 项目容器从紧凑集合中选择一个值。

Controls_ChooseOneValueFromASmallVisible.en-US: Choose one value from a small, visible, mutually exclusive option set.
Controls_ChooseOneValueFromASmallVisible.zh-CN: 从一组数量较少、全部可见且互斥的选项中选择一个值。

Controls_ChooseScrollBarVisibilityWithTh.en-US: Choose scroll-bar visibility with the native WPF properties and use IsSmoothScrollingEnabled to animate wheel movement. ScrollViewer always applies the standard Flourish scroll-bar geometry. Normal wheel input scrolls internally and bubbles at boundaries.
Controls_ChooseScrollBarVisibilityWithTh.zh-CN: 使用 WPF 原生属性选择滚动条可见性，并通过 IsSmoothScrollingEnabled 为滚轮移动添加动画。ScrollViewer 始终应用标准 Flourish 滚动条几何尺寸。普通滚轮输入会在内部滚动，并在边界处冒泡。

Controls_ChooseTopDownWhenABannerDiagram.en-US: Choose TopDown when a banner, diagram, or other wide presentation should establish context before the header text. PresenterPosition does not rearrange this vertical mode, and HeaderChunk still occupies a complete row.
Controls_ChooseTopDownWhenABannerDiagram.zh-CN: 当横幅、图表或其他宽幅展示内容需要在页眉文本之前建立上下文时，请选择 TopDown。PresenterPosition 不会重新排列这种纵向模式，HeaderChunk 仍会占据完整一行。

Controls_ChooseVerticalForACardShapedSel.en-US: Choose Vertical for a card-shaped selection. Icon accepts arbitrary content but is rendered only by the Vertical layout.
Controls_ChooseVerticalForACardShapedSel.zh-CN: 卡片式选择请使用 Vertical。Icon 接受任意内容，但只会在 Vertical 布局中呈现。

Controls_SetTheContentUsedByPersistentAn.en-US: Set the content used by persistent and timed status items.

Controls_SetsConciseHelpContentForThePop.en-US: Sets concise help content for the popup.

Controls_SingleOrMultiLineEditableTextIn.en-US: Single- or multi-line editable text input.
Controls_SingleOrMultiLineEditableTextIn.zh-CN: 可编辑的单行或多行文本输入。

Controls_SplitPlacesPresentationBesideTh.en-US: Split places Presentation beside the copy-and-body region.
Controls_SplitPlacesPresentationBesideTh.zh-CN: Split 将 Presentation 放在文案与 Body 区域旁边。

Controls_SuppliesOptionalIconContentRend.en-US: Supplies optional icon content rendered only by the Vertical layout.

Controls_SwitchBetweenIconOnlyAndIconWit.en-US: Switch between icon-only and icon-with-text presentation.
Controls_SwitchBetweenIconOnlyAndIconWit.zh-CN: 在仅图标和图标加文本的呈现方式之间切换。

Controls_SwitchesBetweenPhysicalAndLogic.en-US: Switches between physical and logical scrolling.
Controls_SwitchesBetweenPhysicalAndLogic.zh-CN: 在物理滚动与逻辑滚动之间切换。

Controls_TabularDataWithoutTrappingPageW.en-US: Tabular data without trapping page wheel scrolling.
Controls_TabularDataWithoutTrappingPageW.zh-CN: 不会截断页面滚轮滚动的表格数据。

Controls_TargetSendsFocusToTheRelatedCon.en-US: Target sends focus to the related control when the access key is invoked.
Controls_TargetSendsFocusToTheRelatedCon.zh-CN: 调用访问键时，Target 会将焦点发送至关联控件。

Controls_TextUpdatesThroughTheRegularWPF.en-US: Text updates through the regular WPF binding and TextChanged contracts.
Controls_TextUpdatesThroughTheRegularWPF.zh-CN: 文本通过常规 WPF 绑定和 TextChanged 约定进行更新。

Controls_TextUsesTheSameBindingValidatio.en-US: Text uses the same binding, validation, and change notification contract as FlourishTextBox.
Controls_TextUsesTheSameBindingValidatio.zh-CN: Text 使用与 FlourishTextBox 相同的绑定、验证和更改通知约定。

Controls_TheCanonicalScrollingRootForAFl.en-US: The canonical scrolling root for a Flourish page.
Controls_TheCanonicalScrollingRootForAFl.zh-CN: Flourish 页面的标准滚动根容器。

Controls_TheCompleteSurfaceIsOneFocusabl.en-US: The complete surface is one focusable action, so its icon, title, and supporting copy share the same pointer and keyboard target.
Controls_TheCompleteSurfaceIsOneFocusabl.zh-CN: 整个表面是一个可聚焦操作，因此图标、标题和辅助文案共享同一个指针及键盘目标。

Controls_TheCopyActionPreservesEveryNewl.en-US: The copy action preserves every newline and indentation character in Text.
Controls_TheCopyActionPreservesEveryNewl.zh-CN: 复制操作会保留 Text 中的每个换行符和缩进字符。

Controls_TheDeepestScrollableViewportCon.en-US: The deepest scrollable viewport consumes wheel input only while it can move in that direction.
Controls_TheDeepestScrollableViewportCon.zh-CN: 最深层的可滚动视口只会在仍能沿该方向移动时消耗滚轮输入。

Controls_TheDefaultMaskProtectsTheVisibl.en-US: The default mask protects the visible value while the editor has focus.
Controls_TheDefaultMaskProtectsTheVisibl.zh-CN: 编辑器获得焦点时，默认掩码会保护可见值。

Controls_TheEnabledButtonAcceptsPointerA.en-US: The enabled button accepts pointer and keyboard focus and exposes its icon and visible command label.
Controls_TheEnabledButtonAcceptsPointerA.zh-CN: 已启用的按钮可接受指针和键盘焦点，并公开其图标及可见命令标签。

Controls_TheGeneralPurposeRoleForRowsOrC.en-US: The general-purpose role for rows or columns in an application Grid.

Controls_ThePlaceholderCollapsesWhenAQue.en-US: The placeholder collapses when a query exists or the field receives focus.

Controls_ThePresentationFillsTheSurfaceW.en-US: The presentation fills the surface while the copy remains readable above its scrim.
Controls_ThePresentationFillsTheSurfaceW.zh-CN: 展示内容铺满界面，文案则在遮罩层上方保持清晰可读。

Controls_TheSameAssociationWorksForSelec.en-US: The same association works for selectors and other focusable controls.
Controls_TheSameAssociationWorksForSelec.zh-CN: 相同的关联方式也适用于选择器和其他可聚焦控件。

Controls_TheShellEdgeRoleWithHorizontalC.en-US: The shell-edge role with horizontal column-resize defaults and the same geometry as Standard.
Controls_TheShellEdgeRoleWithHorizontalC.zh-CN: 位于 Shell 边缘的角色，默认水平调整列宽，并具有与 Standard 相同的几何尺寸。

Controls_TheSingleEmphasizedHeaderAtTheT.en-US: The single emphasized header at the top of a page.
Controls_TheSingleEmphasizedHeaderAtTheT.zh-CN: 页面顶部唯一的强调型页眉。

Controls_TheStandardScrollBarPreservesAU.en-US: The standard scroll bar preserves a usable pointer target while keeping its visible thumb light. Wheel input moves the deepest viewport first and bubbles to the page at a boundary.
Controls_TheStandardScrollBarPreservesAU.zh-CN: 标准滚动条在保持滑块轻盈可见的同时，也保留了易于操作的指针目标。滚轮输入会先移动最深层视口，并在到达边界时冒泡至页面。

Controls_ThisActionRefreshesTheCurrentWo.en-US: This action refreshes the current workspace.
Controls_ThisActionRefreshesTheCurrentWo.zh-CN: 此操作会刷新当前工作区。

Controls_ThisGalleryPageIsItselfHostedBy.en-US: This Gallery page is itself hosted by PageBody: one leading HeaderChunk is followed by full-width Chunks.
Controls_ThisGalleryPageIsItselfHostedBy.zh-CN: 这个 Gallery 页面本身由 PageBody 承载：一个页首 HeaderChunk 后跟若干全宽 Chunk。

Controls_ThisPageWasNotPresentInConfigNa.en-US: This page was not present in ConfigNavigation; its route and menu entry were registered while Gallery was already running.

Controls_ToggleTheShellLANIndicator_5348.zh-CN: 切换 Shell 的局域网指示器。

Controls_ToggleTheShellPowerIndicator_4D.zh-CN: 切换 Shell 的电源指示器。

Controls_TopDownIsTheOnlyPresenterModeIn.en-US: TopDown is the only Presenter mode intended for multi-column placement. It puts Presentation first, followed by a left-aligned Title, Content, and Body group.
Controls_TopDownIsTheOnlyPresenterModeIn.zh-CN: TopDown 是唯一适用于多列放置的 Presenter 模式。它首先放置 Presentation，随后是左对齐的 Title、Content 和 Body 组。

Controls_TopDownPlacesPresentationAboveA.en-US: TopDown places Presentation above a left-aligned copy-and-body region.
Controls_TopDownPlacesPresentationAboveA.zh-CN: TopDown 将 Presentation 放在左对齐的文案与 Body 区域上方。

Controls_TrueUsesACheckMarkAndHighlights.en-US: True uses a check mark and highlights the content and boundary.
Controls_TrueUsesACheckMarkAndHighlights.zh-CN: True 使用勾号，并高亮内容和边界。

Controls_UseASimpleToolTipStringWhenNoCo.en-US: Use a simple ToolTip string when no control-level configuration is required. Native ToolTipService attached properties on the host tune the initial delay and visible duration without changing the shared Flourish treatment.
Controls_UseASimpleToolTipStringWhenNoCo.zh-CN: 无需控件级配置时，请使用简单的 ToolTip 字符串。宿主上的原生 ToolTipService 附加属性可调整初始延迟和显示时长，而不会改变共享的 Flourish 样式。

Controls_UseAToolTipOrAutomationNameWhen.en-US: Use a ToolTip or automation name when the action has no visible label.
Controls_UseAToolTipOrAutomationNameWhen.zh-CN: 当操作没有可见标签时，请使用 ToolTip 或自动化名称。

Controls_UseBorderlessWhenEntriesReprese.en-US: Use Borderless when entries represent destinations or commands. Explicit FlourishListBoxItem containers can mark group headings and command entries; IsCompact collapses their geometry without changing selection semantics.
Controls_UseBorderlessWhenEntriesReprese.zh-CN: 当条目代表目标或命令时使用 Borderless。显式的 FlourishListBoxItem 容器可标记分组标题和命令条目；IsCompact 会收缩其几何尺寸，但不会改变选择语义。

Controls_UseButtonOrCardButtonForActivat.en-US: Use Button or CardButton for activation. Card is an information surface and is not an Overlay trigger.
Controls_UseButtonOrCardButtonForActivat.zh-CN: 使用 Button 或 CardButton 进行激活。Card 是信息界面，不能作为 Overlay 触发器。

Controls_UseCardButtonWhenTitleContentAn.en-US: Use CardButton when Title, Content, and Icon describe one destination or command and the complete surface should respond to pointer, keyboard, and command activation. Each visual property is optional and collapses when omitted. Choose Standard for neutral navigation, Tonal for gentle emphasis, Filled for the principal action, or Elevated for surface separation; use ActionCard when only an embedded control should be interactive.
Controls_UseCardButtonWhenTitleContentAn.zh-CN: 当 Title、Content 和 Icon 共同描述一个目标或命令，且整个表面都应响应指针、键盘和命令激活时，请使用 CardButton。每个视觉属性都是可选的，省略后会自动折叠。中性导航使用 Standard，轻度强调使用 Tonal，主要操作使用 Filled，界面分层使用 Elevated；若仅嵌入的控件需要交互，请使用 ActionCard。

Controls_UseCardForOneOptionalTitleOnePa.en-US: Use Card for one optional Title, one paragraph of Content, and at most one Icon; omitted regions collapse. Choose Standard, Tonal, Filled, or Elevated according to surface emphasis, and set IconPosition to Left, Top, Right, or Bottom. Card is terminal display content—use Presenter for composed visuals and Document for multiple paragraphs.
Controls_UseCardForOneOptionalTitleOnePa.zh-CN: Card 可包含一个可选的 Title、一段 Content 和至多一个 Icon；省略的区域会自动折叠。根据界面强调程度选择 Standard、Tonal、Filled 或 Elevated，并将 IconPosition 设置为 Left、Top、Right 或 Bottom。Card 是终端显示内容；组合视觉内容请使用 Presenter，多段落内容请使用 Document。

Controls_UseCardWhenATitleAndOneConciseB.en-US: Use Card when a title and one concise block of text are enough.
Controls_UseCardWhenATitleAndOneConciseB.zh-CN: 当一个标题和一段简洁文本已经足够时，请使用 Card。

Controls_UseCardWhenConciseCopyNeedsExac.en-US: Use Card when concise copy needs exactly one icon and no arbitrary child controls.
Controls_UseCardWhenConciseCopyNeedsExac.zh-CN: 当简洁文案只需要一个图标且不需要任意子控件时，请使用 Card。

Controls_UseCardWhenOneConciseBlockOfCop.en-US: Use Card when one concise block of copy is enough.
Controls_UseCardWhenOneConciseBlockOfCop.zh-CN: 当一段简洁文案已经足够时，请使用 Card。

Controls_UseDocumentWhenTheContentNeedsS.en-US: Use Document when the content needs several distinct Paragraph elements.
Controls_UseDocumentWhenTheContentNeedsS.zh-CN: 当内容需要多个彼此独立的 Paragraph 元素时，请使用 Document。

Controls_UseMultipleOrExtendedWhenSevera.en-US: Use Multiple or Extended when several items can be selected. Only realized containers receive indicators, preserving virtualization for long collections.
Controls_UseMultipleOrExtendedWhenSevera.zh-CN: 需要选择多个项目时，请使用 Multiple 或 Extended。只有已实现的容器会获得指示器，从而为长集合保留虚拟化能力。

Controls_UseOverlayOnlyWhenTheImageOrIll.en-US: Use Overlay only when the image or illustration remains an appropriate, readable background in every supported theme. Keep essential contrast in the foreground copy and reserve Body for a small supporting action.
Controls_UseOverlayOnlyWhenTheImageOrIll.zh-CN: 仅当图像或插图在所有支持的主题中都能作为合适且清晰可读的背景时，才使用 Overlay。确保前景文案具有必要的对比度，并仅将 Body 用于小型辅助操作。

Controls_UseParagraphInsideDocumentRathe.en-US: Use Paragraph inside Document rather than as a standalone page-level surface.
Controls_UseParagraphInsideDocumentRathe.zh-CN: 应在 Document 内使用 Paragraph，而不是将其作为独立的页面级界面。

Controls_UsePasswordChangedToMoveASecret.en-US: Use PasswordChanged to move a secret into application-owned secure processing.
Controls_UsePasswordChangedToMoveASecret.zh-CN: 使用 PasswordChanged 将密码传递给应用自行负责的安全处理流程。

Controls_UsePresenterForImagesMultipleIc.en-US: Use Presenter for images, multiple icons, illustrations, or controls arranged with copy.
Controls_UsePresenterForImagesMultipleIc.zh-CN: 需要将图像、多个图标、插图或控件与文案排列时，请使用 Presenter。

Controls_UseStandardBetweenOrdinaryGridD.en-US: Use Standard between ordinary Grid definitions. Place the splitter in an Auto-sized row or column, then set ResizeDirection and ResizeBehavior explicitly so the axis and affected neighbors remain clear. Controls_UseStandardBetweenOrdinaryGridD.zh-CN: 在普通 Grid 定义之间使用 Standard。将拆分器放入 Auto 大小的行或列中，再显式设置 ResizeDirection 和 ResizeBehavior，以明确调整轴及受影响的相邻项。若要支持行，可将拆分器移至 Auto 大小的 Grid.Row，并设置 ResizeDirection="Rows"。

Controls_UseStandardForOrdinarySelectabl.en-US: Use Standard for ordinary selectable collections. Bind ItemsSource and SelectedItem as with native WPF ListBox, using a two-way selection binding to synchronize the active view-model item. Choose Borderless when entries represent destinations or commands, and define group-header or command semantics through FlourishListBoxItem.
Controls_UseStandardForOrdinarySelectabl.zh-CN: 普通可选集合使用 Standard。像原生 WPF ListBox 一样绑定 ItemsSource 和 SelectedItem，并使用双向选择绑定同步视图模型中的活动项目。当条目代表目标或命令时选择 Borderless，并通过 FlourishListBoxItem 定义分组标题或命令语义。

Controls_UseStrongForASurfaceThatRemains.en-US: Use Strong for a surface that remains open until the host handles an explicit dismissal request. A vertical ActionCard is the standard focused layout, while the surrounding Popup remains responsible for visibility and placement.
Controls_UseStrongForASurfaceThatRemains.zh-CN: 对于在宿主处理显式关闭请求前始终保持打开的界面，请使用 Strong。纵向 ActionCard 是标准的聚焦布局，外围 Popup 则继续负责可见性和放置位置。

Controls_UseTemporaryForHoverAffordances.en-US: Use Temporary for hover affordances and short previews. PlacementTarget extends hover tracking across the anchor and overlay; the host opens the Popup when the pointer enters or the trigger is activated.
Controls_UseTemporaryForHoverAffordances.zh-CN: 将 Temporary 用于悬停提示和简短预览。PlacementTarget 会让悬停跟踪覆盖锚点与 Overlay；当指针进入或触发器被激活时，由宿主打开 Popup。
